ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the contiguous fluke surface. Distinct high-contrast white blobs (barnacle clusters) at distal tips. Sparse, circular white focal spots distributed non-uniformly across both ventral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 50 degrees; vertex partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration; right lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) along the trailing edge; left lobe shows more consistent low-frequency wave patterns.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from notch to distal tips; lobes taper to pointed, encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of white circular pixel groups at both distal tips. Multiple individual circular ring scars (white perimeter, dark core) visible on the left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Thin, vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe; faint diagonal linear marks visible on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both lobes; multiple circular scarring events across the ventral surface pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy peripheral biofouling creating an irregular, textured silhouette at the extreme lateral edges of the fluke.
